meta.title: Anton Fedotov | Python Backend Developer
meta.description: Portfolio of Anton Fedotov — Mechanical Design Engineer transitioning into Python Backend Development and QA.

description: Mechanical Design Engineer with practical experience in product development and engineering management.
Currently transitioning into Python Backend Development through real personal projects while studying software architecture, APIs, Docker, PostgreSQL, microservices and modern backend technologies.
My goal is to combine engineering thinking with software engineering to build reliable real-world applications.

about.headline: Engineering experience and a transition into Backend Development.
paragraphs: My background combines several technical fields: mechanical engineering, CAD design, manufacturing, Python Backend Development, and QA Engineering.
I have practical engineering experience in production and continue expanding my software engineering skills through real-world personal projects.
I work with and study REST API, Docker, PostgreSQL, Linux, Git, and Nginx — applying them in practice.
